diff_ref: g4 adds no source diff. Smell-tested the g4 work product itself: the acceptance harness, 5 Python scripts / 828 lines, archived as evidence/g4-{build_sandbox,make_prompts,recompute,assert_control,extract_commands}.py and live at scratchpad/accept419/. The shipped hook diff (scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py, scripts/hooks/gauge_writer_hook.py, scripts/gauge_reader.py, docs/GAUGE_WRITER_HOOK.md) was Fowler-passed at its own gates g1-g3, whose FOWLER_PASS.json records are in this workbench; it is closed and not re-passed here.
repo_standards_ref: docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, reviewer references/global-crew.md, reviewer references/global-everyone.md, and the frozen g4 IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF ('a one-shot acceptance harness, kept runnable but NOT CI-wired, living in the scratchpad outside the repo so it never enters the diff')

smells.finding: recompute.py main() runs ~175 lines and assert_control.py main() ~89, both straight-line sequences of print-then-assert with no branching structure.

override.repo_standard: global-crew.md 'Make the minimal change that satisfies the handoff; no speculative abstraction' plus 'The result artifact IS the task', read against the g4 handoff's explicit instruction that the harness be one-shot, uncommitted, and outside the repo.
override.reason: The printed output of these two functions IS the archived evidence artifact (g4-recompute-output.txt, g4-assert-control-output.txt), so the statement order is the deliverable, not an implementation detail. Extracting helpers would fragment the narrative a reader has to follow top-to-bottom, and buys no locality: each function has exactly one caller and one lifetime. The standard subordinates the smell here specifically because the code is not repo code and will never be maintained.

smells.finding: No classes anywhere in the harness; the five scripts are module-level functions only.

Real and worth raising even for a throwaway. check(ok, label, detail) is duplicated verbatim in recompute.py and assert_control.py; slug_for(path) is duplicated three times (build_sandbox.py, recompute.py, extract_commands.py); and the transcript-line/usage-total parsing is independently re-implemented in recompute.py (usage_total, lines_of) and extract_commands.py (load, results_by_id). This matters beyond the run because the harness is archived as reusable evidence and the next acceptance run will fork it. Observation for Commander, not a blocker.
Each function operates on data it is handed; no function reaches repeatedly into another module's internals.

The tuple (arm name, sandbox directory, settings file, prompt file, ~/.claude/projects slug) travels together through all five scripts and is re-derived from the bare arm string in each. Same root as the duplicated-code finding; one shared arm module would retire both.
Paths are pathlib.Path, agent ids and session uuids are strings guarded by explicit UUID_RE/HEX_RE regexes rather than passed around raw and hoped over.
Widest signature in the harness takes three parameters (recompute_at(transcript, agent_id, observed_at)).

Changing the sandbox layout (spine directory names, corpus location, binding-store path) requires edits in all five scripts. Same root cause as the two findings above; recorded once more because it is the consequence a future acceptance run would actually feel.
Each script has one reason to change: build the sandbox, generate the prompts, recompute the treatment arm, assert the control arm, extract raw commands.
No chained navigation; JSON is read once into a dict and indexed with guarded .get() calls.

No unused hooks, parameters or abstraction layers. make_prompts.py's single TEMPLATE with one substituted field is the opposite of speculative: it is what structurally guarantees the two arms' prompts are byte-identical, and the script self-asserts that identity before exiting.

The harness comments state guarantees the code cannot state itself - e.g. make_prompts.py's docstring recording that nothing in either prompt names an agent, an agent id, or any target number. That is evidence documentation, not cover for unclear code.
